name: Superpowers
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Pi and more
short: Skills that make your coding agent plan, test and review before it writes code.
what: A set of skills that switch on automatically and make your coding agent follow a proper workflow: brainstorm a spec, write a plan, write tests first, hand tasks to sub-agents, review the code, then finish the branch.
who: Anyone using a coding agent on a real project who wants it to plan and test before it starts typing. It's more than you need for quick one-off scripts.
needs: A supported coding agent. You install it separately in each one you use
Your agent's usual plan or API credits. Superpowers itself is free (MIT)

steps.title: Cursor
steps.text: In Agent chat, or search "superpowers" in the plugin marketplace:

steps.title: Codex
steps.text: In Codex CLI run `/plugins`, search for superpowers and choose Install Plugin. In the Codex app, open Plugins in the sidebar and click + next to Superpowers.

steps.title: GitHub Copilot CLI
steps.code:
copilot plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace
copilot plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace

try.label: From the README
try.text:
Let's make a react todo list

If it's installed properly, the agent starts brainstorming with you before it writes any code.

watch: The README says the agent can work on its own for a couple of hours at a time, so expect long runs and heavy token use.
The test-first skill will delete code that was written before its tests. That can feel heavy for small jobs.
An optional visual helper loads a logo from the makers' site, which sends your Superpowers version. Set `SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY` to switch that off.
